translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Hiyyeesatuwaa Uk'k'unniyaawanttuBollan Gakkanaw De'iyaa Iita Kaac'aa

Iitabaa halchchiyaawanttoo, k'ay barenttu hiis'an de'iidde, iitabaa wooti ootsanentto k'oppiyaawantto aayye ana! Wolk'k'ay unttunttu kushiyan de'iyaa diraw, sa'ay wonttiyaa wode, barenttu halchchuwaa poliino.
Unttunttu goshsha gadiyaa amottooppe, asaawaa wolk'k'an akki aggiino; golletuwaa koyooppekka akki aggiino. Asaa maataa yed'd'iide, Aa laataa c'oo bonk'k'iino.

Hewaa diraw, Med'ina Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Be'ite, taani hintte bollan iitabaa ahanaw halchchay; hewaappe hintte kessi akkanaw danddaykkita. Hewe iita wode gidiyaa diraw, hintte otorettiidde simerettanaw danddaykkita.
He gallassi unttunttu hintte bollan leemisi leemisiide k'iliic'ana; k'ay hawaadan yaagi zilaaliidde, hinttena hidoota k'ans's'issana;
Hewaa diraw, gadiyaa es's'an gishiyaa wode, Med'ina Godaa shiik'uwaa giddon ne saamaa kessiyaa itti asaynne de'enna.
Asay taana hawaadan yaagee; «Nu bolla timbbitiyaa odoppa. ‹Hawe hawe hintte bolla hanana› giide ooninne haasayanaw koshshenna. Hewaa mala kawushshay nu bolla mulekka yeenna» yaagiino.

Taani unttuntta, «Hinttenoo Yaak'ooba zaretoo, ‹Med'ina Godaa Ayyaanay danddayanchchaa gidenneeyye? I hewaa malabaa ootsiiyye?› yaagiide hintte oochchanaw bessii?» yaagaad. S'oossay hawaadan yaagee; «Suure ogiyaan biyaawanttoo ta k'aalay lo"obaa ootsee gidennee?

Shin mata wodiyaappe doommiide, ta Asay ittuu ittuwaa bolla morkkiyaadan denddeedda. Hintte saro asatuwaa mayuwaa, olaa k'ofay mulekka bayinnan ammanettiide aad'd'iyaa asatuwaa mayuwaa k'aari akkiita;
ta asaa giddon de'iyaa mac'c'a asatuwaa unttunttu lo"o golliyaappe laaggi kessiita; ta anjjuwaakka unttunttu naanatu bollappe med'inaw akki diggiita.
Denddiide biite! Hawe hinttenttoo shemppiyaa sa'aa gidenna. Ayaw gooppe, ha sa'ay tunatetsaappe denddeeddawaan daro bayeedda.
«Itti c'immiyaa worddanchchay yiide, ‹Hinttew sintsaappe woyniyaa eessaynne matsoyiyaa ushshay guufettana› yaagiide wordduwaa timbbitiyaa odintto, I hinttenttoo timbbitiyaa odiyaawaa gidana.

«Hinttenoo, Yaak'ooba zaretoo, taani hinttena ubbaakka shiishshana; taani Israa'eeliyaa asaappe atteedawantta tumuwaappe ubbaakka shiishshana. Dorssatuu kaaluwaan shiik'iyaawaadaninne dorssaa wudii hentsaa gaden shiik'iyaawaadan, taani unttuntta ittippe shiishshaade wotsana. He sa'ay daro asaa shabbaretussan kumana.

Unttuntta kessiyaawe unttunttuppe sintsatiide kesana; unttunttukka penggiyaa mentsiide, hewaana kesiide baana. Med'ina Goday bare huup'iyaan unttunttoo kaatiyaa gidiide, unttuntta sintsaw aad'd'iide, unttuntta kaaletsana» yaagee.
